name: HRBPilot 人事助手
description: 查询公司制度原文、浏览你有权查看的人事案件，并为敏感操作提交审批。
description_zh: 查询公司制度原文、浏览你有权查看的人事案件，并为敏感操作提交审批。所有回答都带制度来源；涉及员工处分的动作只提交审批，不会直接执行。
description_en: Search company policy documents with citations, browse the HR cases you are allowed to see, and submit approval requests for sensitive actions. Every answer cites its source; actions affecting employees are only submitted for approval, never executed directly.
examples_zh: 公司的年假是怎么规定的？
帮我找一下关于加班费的政策原文
列一下我有权限查看的人事案件
我想给这个案件提交一条处理建议，需要谁审批？
刚才提交的那个审批现在是什么状态？
examples_en: What is our annual leave policy?
Find the original policy text about overtime pay
List the HR cases I have access to
Submit a proposed action for this case — who needs to approve it?
What is the status of the approval I just submitted?
